checks.details: No significant DRY violations in production code. tRPC client, router, and provider are each defined once.

Test setup boilerplate is repeated in system-router.test.ts -- the caller creation pattern appears 4 times and could be extracted to a beforeEach block. Also, vi.mock('electron-trpc/renderer') is duplicated across 3 shared test files.
SSOT compliance: tRPC client code in shared/trpc/ (single source), AppRouter type exported once from router.ts.
KISS compliance: Minimal healthCheck-only implementation, no unnecessary abstractions or frameworks.

RouterInputs and RouterOutputs types are exported from router.ts but never imported. createContext() from context.ts is only used in tests. Both are standard tRPC patterns specified in the design and serve as intentional API surface.
HealthCheckOutput type is exported but never imported outside tests. Standard tRPC pattern, acceptable as public API.
No dead code detected. Every new file is properly imported and used in the dependency chain.
No TODO/FIXME/PLACEHOLDER comments in any new tRPC files.
CREATE target: src/main/trpc/context.ts, router.ts, routers/system.ts, handler.ts all exist
CREATE target: src/preload/trpc.ts, src/shared/trpc/client.ts, src/shared/trpc/provider.tsx all exist
UPDATE targets: src/main/index.ts, src/renderer/App.tsx, src/remote-ui/App.tsx, src/preload/index.ts, package.json all updated correctly
Additional handler.ts file created beyond design spec -- positive deviation for better separation of concerns and testability

console.warn used in provider.tsx for ipcLink unavailability in Remote UI environment. Per logging.md, console.* should be avoided, but projectLogger is a Main Process service unavailable in Renderer-side code. Acceptable as bootstrap-adjacent logging.
Main Process logging correctly uses projectLogger per logging.md guidelines (Requirement 8.5).
No 'any' types used anywhere in the new code.
